name: bookvault-mcp
description: Bookvault (CopyTECH (UK) Ltd t/a Printondemand-worldwide) (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products,

platform_mcp_bookvault_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BOOKVAULT_API_KEY
platform_mcp_bookvault_api_key.description: Bookvault API key from the portal's Apps page (Bookvault API > Generate Credentials; shown once), sent as `Authorization: basic <key>`. Supply the key exactly as displayed, starting with bv_.

platform_mcp_bookvault_partner.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BOOKVAULT_PARTNER
platform_mcp_bookvault_partner.description: Print partner for create_order (required by Bookvault): Bookvault_UK, Bookvault_US, Bookvault_AU or Bookvault_CA.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v4/account: {details{firstName, lastName, email, accountRole}, settings{planName}, setup{addedFunds, placedOrder}, ...}. The account payload also carries billing and bank details; treat `account` as sensitive.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: GET /v4/titles?titlesPerPage=&pageNumber= lists YOUR library titles (print-on-demand books) with specifications and pricing in `raw`; `query` and `category` are not accepted (POST /v4/titles filters are not mapped). `id` is the 13-digit ISBN.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: GET /v4/title/{ISBN}: one library title with publishing progress, specifications (pages, binding, size, stocks), pricing and linked apps in `raw`.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Places a real print order that Bookvault charges to the account (production + dispatch). `shipping_address` is Bookvault's address {addressee, address1, address2, town, county (2-letter state for US/CA), countryCode (ISO), postCode, email, telNumber}; `items` are orderLines [{lineNumber (1, 2, ...), isbn, quantity}]; `shipping_option` is required and is the service rule Quickest, Cheapest, Tracked, CheapestTracked or NotSpecified. The print partner comes from the `partner` setting; docRef (your reference) is a fresh UUID. Orders shipped outside the partner's country also need a customsDeclaration, which this tool does not send. Validate first with POST /v4/order/validate (not mapped).

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET /v4/order?type=PodRef&value={id} (the podRef create_order returns): identification, metadata{status, dateCreated, partner}, financials.orderCost{productionCost, dispatchCost, tax, grandTotal}, fulfillment{address, service, trackingDetails{trackingNumber, combinedURL, servName}}.
